method: numerical search of this atlas: mirror (x <-> y) symmetric Levenberg-Marquardt search in float64 from random starts with 3 node(s) on the mirror axis (code/tri_search.py, mode mirror; N = 2 a + b, a pairs and b axis nodes), start points from an arcsine law, degree continuation, the nodes kept in the triangle by box bounds on a collapsed parametrisation and the weights >= 0; all nodes lie inside the triangle; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm with the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py); the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
